entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet publish fails when publish directory has a semi-colon #49671
  • Empty `#:project` appears to add a project item for the app directory #49670
  • Replace ApplicationInsights dependency with OpenTelemetry libraries #49668
  • Enable the dotnet CLI to be shipped as a Native AOT application #49667
    11.0.1xx

Closed

  • Containers targets don't ensure that ComputeContainerConfig has all necessary data to compute runtime-specific information #49586
